Legal and court starting help

Prepare, verify and decide what kind of help you need.

Franklin Navigator provides general organization and help finding the right source—not legal advice, representation, filing, deadline calculation or a lawyer recommendation. Tennessee, county, court and case details matter.

Common starting areas

  • Family, safety and caregiving
  • Housing, property and eviction
  • Work, pay and discrimination
  • Debt, bankruptcy and consumer issues
  • Benefits, disability and veterans
  • Criminal, traffic and court papers
  • Immigration and identity records
  • Wills, probate and elder law
  • Business, contracts and taxes
  • Injury, insurance and vehicle accidents

Find legal-service listings

Official and local starting points

  • Williamson County Circuit Court ClerkWilliamson County · confirm current details
  • Williamson County General Sessions CourtWilliamson County · confirm current details
  • Bridges Domestic Violence CenterLocal or regional · confirm current details
  • Franklin Police domestic-violence helpFranklin · confirm current details
  • Legal Aid Society get helpWilliamson County · confirm current details
  • Legal Aid Society clinics and eventsLocal or regional · confirm current details

Court rules, legal-aid capacity, clinic dates and safety-service availability can change. Confirm directly before relying on a route.

Know the boundaries before you share.

  • Use broad categories here; keep private stories, medical facts, legal communications and document text off this public page.
  • A listing is not endorsement, referral, current availability or proof that a provider fits your situation.
  • Membership never changes urgent help, safety information, factual accuracy, credentials or ordinary directory placement.
  • You choose whether to contact an outside organization or professional. Franklin Navigator does not send your plan.
